title: ESA scientists recognize Tyler at the Vatican Observatory
summary: Diana Pasulka tells of ESA scientists recognize Tyler at the Vatican Observatory, about unspecified (2010s) at Castel Gandolfo, Vatican Observatory, Italy, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Tim Taylor let into Vatican archives unescorted
as_told.place_text: Vatican Observatory and archives, Vatican City

plain: Diana Pasulka, a religious studies professor who writes about belief in UFOs, says she was at the Vatican Observatory at Castel Gandolfo in Italy sometime in the 2010s. She says that when a man she calls Tyler, a space industry figure she keeps anonymous, was introduced by his real name, the scientists there from ESA, the European Space Agency, erupted in recognition. Guy Consolmagno, a Jesuit astronomer at the observatory, is part of the story, which she tells to show that Tyler is a real and respected figure.
